title: Bright Ripe Crops
description: This texture pack Makes the crops in minecraft bright so that you can tell it apart from growing crops
body:
This Texture pack makes your grown crops bright so that you know which of your crops are grown. This is especially useful when you have big farmlands and dont have the time to distingish grown crops from ungrown.

It can be used on basicly any version because it only changes the crop textures(i dont have time to make other versions)
